title: Existing-Client Project Setup target application flow

surfaces.currentBehavior: Core-only observable existing-Client Project Setup application model combines exact local evidence, manages fail-closed selection and stable retry identity, and submits through ProjectSetupUseCase.
surfaces.notes: Exact READY CI passed before implementation; independent executable review returned final GO after four corrections.

surfaces: two-stream form preparation, stable selection state, and one ProjectSetupUseCase submission
securityRequirements: Accept only already-materialized Account-bound typed snapshots and expose no provider, SQL, credential, or caller-authored scope
syncRequirements: Preserve partial, stale, ready, incomplete, and authoritative-empty distinctions without inventing completeness

migration.rule: Create no source import or transformation.
reconciliation: Use stable typed Client/category identities rather than copied display text

acceptance: The real model passes two-stream, selection, submission, receipt, cancellation, and error tests

surfaces.currentBehavior: Nine deterministic Project Setup application-model tests cover independently arriving evidence, false-empty meaning, selection, exact submission, failures, retry, receipts, cancellation and shutdown.
surfaces.notes: Controlled streams, an advancing clock and fake backend-neutral setup operator provide bounded deterministic proof.

securityRequirements: Use synthetic Account, Principal, Client, Project, category, and Operation identities only
syncRequirements: Exercise both stream arrival orders, readiness changes, cancellation, and post-cancel silence

migration.rule: Use no Firebase export or hosted target data.
reconciliation: Assert exact form preparation and operation receipts

acceptance: All frozen Project Setup application-model cases pass deterministically

surfaces.currentBehavior: Thin target-app adapter forwards the Account-bound runtime Client/category streams and Project setup operation into the backend-neutral application-model runtime value.
surfaces.notes: The adapter may forward only Account-bound Client/category watches and Project setup; policy remains in verified Core contracts.

securityRequirements: Expose no raw Account rebinding, database, query, SQL, visibility policy, or credential
syncRequirements: Forward runtime snapshots and cancellation without rewriting their readiness evidence

reconciliation: Do not access source Firebase code or data

tests: target environment source/build-boundary checks and complete staging builds
acceptance: The app adapter remains the only PowerSync-aware Project Setup application-flow leaf
